scope: Getting a product recommended by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini/AI Overviews, Perplexity, Copilot) through live retrieval and future training data. Public sources only.

tactics.tactic: Get included in the third-party pages assistants already cite for the category: 'best X' roundups, alternative directories, review sites. Pitch editors with a specific angle; list on directories.
tactics.fits: Any product; the main lever for small brands with no AI visibility.

cases.what: zapier.com was 34% of citations in to-do app answers (one roundup 27%); reddit.com 25%; techradar.com 13% (ChatGPT + AI Mode, 442 responses, Jul–Nov 2026)
AI search shows systematic bias toward earned third-party media over brand-owned pages
Web brand mentions correlate 0.664 with AI Overview visibility vs 0.218 for backlinks

counterEvidence: Correlational and vendor-measured; whether a given pitch lands is unknown.
tactics.transferLimits: Editors include products with users or a distinctive angle; pitch after there is something to show.

tactics.tactic: Answer-first pages for specific needs the product meets (constraints, use cases), enriched with real cited statistics and quotations.
tactics.fits: Small brands that cannot win generic 'best X' questions.

cases.what: Brands absent from generic answers appear when the question carries distinctive needs or constraints
Adding quotations (~+41%), statistics (~+33%) and cited sources (~+28%) raised visibility in generative answers, most for low-ranked sources

counterEvidence: GEO gains were measured on 2023 engines with fixed source sets; they do not address being retrieved at all.
tactics.transferLimits: Never fabricate statistics or quotes; cite real sources.

tactics.tactic: Make sure the site is indexed where assistants retrieve: Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools (Copilot citation report), IndexNow; allow search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot).
tactics.fits: Every site; prerequisite for live-retrieval visibility.

cases.what: AI features require indexing and snippet eligibility; no special optimizations or AI text files needed
OAI-SearchBot determines appearance in ChatGPT search; GPTBot (training) is separate
Claude-SearchBot indexes for search; blocking it reduces visibility

counterEvidence: llms.txt: 97% of files received no requests and Google does not support it (https://ahrefs.com/blog/llmstxt-study).

tactics.tactic: Build consistent, independent mentions on crawled sites (same name everywhere, sameAs links in Organization schema) so future models learn the product exists.
tactics.fits: Long horizon; compounds with every other tactic.

cases.what: A model's knowledge of an entity scales with how many training documents mention it

tactics.transferLimits: Training cutoffs lag months to years; Common Crawl inclusion cannot be forced. Wikipedia requires independent coverage first.

tactics.tactic: Measure AI visibility as mention rate across repeated runs of fixed, unbranded, specific-need prompts per engine, monthly; record cited URLs.

cases.what: The same prompt rarely returns the same list twice; appearance rate is steadier than position

tactics.transferLimits: Requires access to each assistant; record unavailable engines as unavailable, never zero.
